    b = sl * math.cos(math.radians(30))
    w = b * 2
    h = 2 * sl

    starty = starty - h
    endx = endx + w
    endy = endy + h

    origy = starty
    xoffset = b

    counter = 0

        while startx < endx:
            p1x = startx
            p1y = starty + p
            p2x = startx
            p2y = starty + (3 * p)
            p3x = startx + b
            p3y = starty + h
            p4x = startx + w
            p4y = starty + (3 * p)
            p5x = startx + w
            p5y = starty + p
            p6x = startx + b
            p6y = starty
            poly = [
                (p1x, p1y),
                (p2x, p2y),
                (p3x, p3y),
                (p4x, p4y),
                (p5x, p5y),
                (p6x, p6y),

            counter += 1
            startx += w
        starty += yoffset
